title: Reviewed head A is superseded by remote head B; review stays bound to its original range; unavailable source yields unknown current state

facets.EVENTS: Append-only records. Each has event_id (stable), payload_digest, evidence_class, observer, author, observation_time, effective_time, scope, source_uri, source_anchor, exact bytes + hash_alg + hash + encoding where bytes exist.
facets.CURRENT: Current applicable view keyed by (scope, fact_key). Each entry carries value, freshness state (live|stale|unknown), as_of time, and the event_id it derives from.
facets.DELIVERY: Per (event_id, replica) states drawn from: local_durable, queued, remote_received, admitted, materialized, injected, task_acked, plus retry/ack reconciliation counters.
facets.HISTORY: As-of query surface returning what CURRENT held at a past instant, plus all superseded values with their original observation times.
facets.QUALIFY: Action-qualification decision records: {action, subject, decision, reasons[], cited_event_ids[], cited_evidence_classes[], source_freshness_used, decided_at}.

abstract_store_model.vocabulary_note: Implementations may use different labels. A conformance mapping from implementation labels to these five facets and to the freshness states live|stale|unknown MUST be declared before the run and MUST NOT be revised after seeing results.

hosts.role: second computer holding replica of sto-beacon

repositories.note: id is the identity; remote_url/path/branch are mutable labels and must never be used as identity

declared_policy.live_check_definition: A request to the authoritative remote source of record for pr-4417 that returns the remote head. A local ref read, local branch existence test, working-tree inspection, memory-index refresh or cache read is NOT a live check.
declared_policy.on_source_unavailable: CURRENT.pr.head_revision freshness := unknown; last-known value retained in HISTORY with its original observation time; consequential actions refuse.

assertions.statement: After step 7, CURRENT.pr-4417.head_revision equals head_b with freshness=live and as_of=2026-03-02T11:41:35Z.
evt-c01-002 still exists unmodified after the head change, with its scope range still base=b0/head=A and its source_byte_hash unchanged.
No qualification decision at head_b cites evt-c01-002 as satisfying the review prerequisite; the t5 decision is not_qualified.
The t3 decision is refused for staleness and does NOT return qualified on the strength of the passing review at head A.

At t9 CURRENT.pr-4417.head_revision does NOT return head_b as a current value; it returns freshness=unknown with the last-known value clearly marked historical and carrying its original observation time.
The t9 refusal reason set contains no local-only evidence (local ref, branch existence, working tree, index refresh, cache) presented as a live source check.

An as-of query at 2026-03-02T09:30:00Z returns head_revision=head_a and review_prerequisite=satisfied for range b0..A, i.e. the historical view is preserved and is not rewritten by the later head change.

After evt-c01-005, mark_review_prerequisite_satisfied at head_b returns qualified citing evt-c01-005 — proving the gate is capable of returning qualified and A03 is not passing merely because everything is denied.
Even with evt-c01-005 present, merge_pr at head_b is not_qualified because review satisfaction is not merge authority and hum-mara-quill holds no merge grant.

evt-c01-002 is admitted exactly once on sto-beacon@hst-sable despite the lost acknowledgement and the identical retry; the retry is visible as a retry and the receipt is reconciled, not silently dropped.
The three deliveries of evt-c01-004 produce exactly one admitted copy and exactly one head transition; no duplicate semantic effect and no second qualification decision are produced.
The source-byte hash of evt-c01-002 and the rendered-output hash of evt-c01-003 are different values and both are retained; neither is normalized into the other.

evt-c01-004 records base and head as full revision identities plus the explicit fact that head_a is not an ancestor of head_b; ancestry is recorded as observed data, not inferred from the ordering of events.
For each of t3, t5, t7 the store can name the exact record/version IDs selected, emitted and delivered to that turn, and the t3 packet does not include evt-c01-004 (which did not yet exist).
At no point does the review-prerequisite entry in CURRENT report satisfied for a range whose head is not head_a (before t7) — no range widening, no 'approved PR' boolean detached from a range.

No event is created that attributes to hum-mara-quill an approval of head_b before evt-c01-005; no promotion of the head-A review into a head-B review occurs under any label (re-approval, carry-forward, refresh).
Every qualification decision names the evidence class of each cited record, and no decision cites a derived_rendering or model_inference record as an authorization source.
Repository identity in every record is rpo-lantern; changing the mutable remote_url label between t6 and t7 changes no identity, no scope match and no decision.
